description: Bookmarks 1.2 (the JSON store's recovery): run while bookmarks.json is missing or can't be read and no snapshot took its place on its own (Capabilities' StoreReadOnlyReason DataMissing or DataUnreadable; scripts/README.md, "The JSON store checks"). As admin, the settings page's Data tab says so and offers Restore of the listed snapshots (not a newer schema's, nor since the hardening's review one that can't be read) and Start empty. With a snapshot of the current schema listed, its Restore opens the kit's dialog with the focus on Cancel; Cancel changes nothing; Restore, confirmed, restores it: the report names it, the data is writable at once, the store RestoredFromSnapshot with the banner saying an admin did it, and the way out gone. With none, Start empty the same way (Escape cancels first): RecoveredEmpty.

steps.name: read-only: the data missing or unreadable
the snapshot to restore: the newest of this schema, if any
the page is loaded, with the store's banner
what the page offers
steps.eval: (p => ({ text: p.querySelector('#BookmarksRecoveryText').textContent, startEmpty: !p.querySelector('#BookmarksStartEmpty').disabled, blocked: !!p.querySelector('#BookmarksSnapshots .bookmarksSnapshotsBlocked'), restore: Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('#BookmarksSnapshots button.bookmarksRestore')).map(b => ({ name: b.getAttribute('data-name'), disabled: b.disabled })) }))(document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'))

steps.name: it says why, offers Start empty, and Restore for each snapshot but a newer schema's or one that can't be read
steps.assert: (o => o.text.indexOf(__vars.before.StoreReadOnlyReason === 'DataUnreadable' ? 'The bookmark data couldn\'t be read' : 'The bookmark data is missing') === 0 && o.text.indexOf('Restore one of the snapshots below, or start empty. Every snapshot is kept either way') > 0 && o.startEmpty && !o.blocked && JSON.stringify(o.restore.map(r => r.name)) === JSON.stringify(__vars.snapshots.Snapshots.map(s => s.Name)) && o.restore.every((r, i) => r.disabled === (v => v === null || v === undefined || v > 2)(__vars.snapshots.Snapshots[i].SchemaVersion)))(__vars.offered)

steps.name: Restore: the snapshot's button
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide) #BookmarksSnapshots button.bookmarksRestore[data-name="' + __vars.target + '"]'); b.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); b.click(); return true;

steps.name: Restore: the focus starts on Cancel
Restore: it says the data can be changed again at once, and every snapshot is kept
steps.assert: /^Restore the snapshot of .+\? The bookmark data becomes the snapshot's, and can be changed again at once; .+Every snapshot is kept, this one too\.$/.test(__vars.dialogText)

steps.name: Restore: it names the snapshot, says the data can be changed again, and that every snapshot is kept
steps.assert: __vars.report.indexOf('Restored ' + __vars.target + ' (') === 0 && __vars.report.indexOf('the bookmark data can be changed again.') > 0 && __vars.report.indexOf('Every snapshot is kept until you restore one of them.') > 0 && (__vars.before.StoreReadOnlyReason !== 'DataUnreadable' || /What couldn't be read is kept as bookmarks\.json\.corrupt-\d{14}/.test(__vars.report))

steps.name: Start empty: the button
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide) #BookmarksStartEmpty'); b.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); b.click(); return true;

steps.name: Start empty: the focus starts on Cancel
Start empty: what the dialog says
Start empty: it says what goes, that every snapshot is kept, and when to do it
steps.assert: __vars.dialogText.indexOf('Start the bookmark data empty? Every user\'s bookmarks are gone from Bookmarks until a snapshot that holds them is restored. Every snapshot is kept') === 0 && __vars.dialogText.indexOf('Only do this when none of the snapshots holds the bookmarks you want.') > 0

steps.name: Start empty: it says so, and that every snapshot is kept
steps.assert: __vars.report.indexOf('The bookmark data starts empty, and can be changed again.') === 0 && __vars.report.indexOf('Every snapshot is kept until you restore one of them.') > 0 && (__vars.before.StoreReadOnlyReason !== 'DataUnreadable' || /What couldn't be read is kept as bookmarks\.json\.corrupt-\d{14}/.test(__vars.report))

steps.name: the data can be changed again
the store says an admin did it
steps.assert: (s => s.ReadOnly === false && (__vars.target ? s.Status === 'RestoredFromSnapshot' && s.Message.indexOf('; an admin restored the data from the snapshot ' + __vars.target + ' taken ') > 0 : s.Status === 'RecoveredEmpty' && s.Message.indexOf('; an admin chose to start empty.') > 0) && s.Message.indexOf('Every snapshot is kept until you restore one of them') > 0)(__vars.diagnostics.Store)

steps.name: the banner at the top is the store's new sentence, and the way out is gone
every snapshot is still there, and kept
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's Home tab pausing its slider as the page is left, excepted)
